title: Write an OUTSTANDING LinkedIn Summary (with Examples)!
speaker: Jeff Su
zh: 【Jeff Su】撰寫出色的 LinkedIn 摘要（附範例）！（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: So recently a career coach I admire a lot, Austin Belcak, wrote an amazing article
cues.en: So recently a career coach I admire a lot, Austin Belcak, wrote an amazing article
cues.zh: 最近，我非常敬佩的一位職業教練奧斯汀·貝爾卡克（Austin Belcak）寫了一篇很棒的文章

cues.text: on how to write a crazy effective LinkedIn summary and includes real life examples and templates.
cues.en: on how to write a crazy effective LinkedIn summary and includes real life examples and templates.
cues.zh: 關於如何撰寫瘋狂有效的 LinkedIn 摘要，包括現實生活中的範例和範本。

cues.text: The only problem?
cues.en: The only problem?
cues.zh: 唯一的問題是什麼？

cues.text: It's 28,683 words.
cues.en: It's 28,683 words.
cues.zh: 共有 28,683 個單字。

cues.text: So being the helpful little elf that I am, in this video I'm gonna first share the key takeaways
cues.en: So being the helpful little elf that I am, in this video I'm gonna first share the key takeaways
cues.zh: 因此，作為一個樂於助人的小精靈，在這個影片中我將首先分享關鍵要點

cues.text: from this comprehensive article, break down the best LinkedIn summary template
cues.en: from this comprehensive article, break down the best LinkedIn summary template
cues.zh: 從這篇綜合文章中，詳細分析了最好的 LinkedIn 摘要模板

cues.text: for job seekers and working professionals, then end with five practical tips you can apply today
cues.en: for job seekers and working professionals, then end with five practical tips you can apply today
cues.zh: 對於求職者和專業人士，最後提供五個您今天可以應用的實用技巧

cues.text: to your own LinkedIn bio.
cues.en: to your own LinkedIn bio.
cues.zh: 到您自己的 LinkedIn 簡歷。

cues.text: Let's get started.
cues.en: Let's get started.
cues.zh: 讓我們開始吧。

cues.text: Hi friends, welcome back to the channel.
cues.en: Hi friends, welcome back to the channel.
cues.zh: 朋友們大家好，歡迎回到頻道。

cues.text: If you're new here, my name is Jeff and, quick disclaimer upfront, Austin did not ask me to make this video.
cues.en: If you're new here, my name is Jeff and, quick disclaimer upfront, Austin did not ask me to make this video.
cues.zh: 如果你是新來的，我叫傑夫，提前宣告一下，奧斯汀並沒有要求我製作這個影片。

cues.text: He still doesn't know who I am.
cues.en: He still doesn't know who I am.
cues.zh: 他還是不知道我是誰。

cues.text: So if one of you could please let him know I'm one of the cool kids as well, that'd be awesome.
cues.en: So if one of you could please let him know I'm one of the cool kids as well, that'd be awesome.
cues.zh: 因此，如果你們中的一個人能讓他知道我也是很酷的孩子之一，那就太好了。

cues.text: Key takeaway one number one on how to get your LinkedIn about section to stand out.
cues.en: Key takeaway one number one on how to get your LinkedIn about section to stand out.
cues.zh: 要點一：如何讓 LinkedIn 的「關於」部分脫穎而出。

cues.text: There is no one-size-fits-all LinkedIn summary because there are different best practices
cues.en: There is no one-size-fits-all LinkedIn summary because there are different best practices
cues.zh: LinkedIn 上沒有一刀切的總結，因為有不同的最佳實踐

cues.text: depending on how you want to position yourself, and the article talks about four in particular,
cues.en: depending on how you want to position yourself, and the article talks about four in particular,
cues.zh: 取決於你想如何定位自己，本文特別談到了四個，

cues.text: job seekers, working professionals, entrepreneurs and thought leaders.
cues.en: job seekers, working professionals, entrepreneurs and thought leaders.
cues.zh: 求職者、專業人士、企業家和思想領袖。

cues.text: Key takeaway number two addresses a common question asked by new and experienced LinkedIn users alike.
cues.en: Key takeaway number two addresses a common question asked by new and experienced LinkedIn users alike.
cues.zh: 第二個要點解決了 LinkedIn 新使用者和經驗豐富的使用者提出的常見問題。

cues.text: What does a LinkedIn bio supposed to achieve anyways?
cues.en: What does a LinkedIn bio supposed to achieve anyways?
cues.zh: LinkedIn 簡介到底該達成什麼目標？

cues.text: Answer, a well-crafted LinkedIn summary compels your target audience, whoever they may be,
cues.en: Answer, a well-crafted LinkedIn summary compels your target audience, whoever they may be,
cues.zh: 答案是，精心設計的 LinkedIn 摘要會迫使您的目標受眾，無論他們是誰，

cues.text: to reach out to you instead of the other way around.
cues.en: to reach out to you instead of the other way around.
cues.zh: 與您聯絡，而不是相反。

cues.text: Key takeaway number three, after coaching thousands of job seekers and analyzing their LinkedIn summaries,
cues.en: Key takeaway number three, after coaching thousands of job seekers and analyzing their LinkedIn summaries,
cues.zh: 第三個要點是，在指導了數千名求職者並分析了他們的 LinkedIn 摘要後，

cues.text: Austin has found common themes in the success cases and incorporates those best practices
cues.en: Austin has found common themes in the success cases and incorporates those best practices
cues.zh: 奧斯汀在成功案例中找到了共同主題，並融入了這些最佳實踐

cues.text: into his LinkedIn summary templates.
cues.en: into his LinkedIn summary templates.
cues.zh: 到他的 LinkedIn 摘要範本中。

cues.text: Dive into the template for job seekers, we start off strong with an intro line
cues.en: Dive into the template for job seekers, we start off strong with an intro line
cues.zh: 深入瞭解求職者的模板，我們從介紹開始

cues.text: that tells the reader what field you're in, how many years of experience you have,
cues.en: that tells the reader what field you're in, how many years of experience you have,
cues.zh: 告訴讀者你在哪個領域，你有多少年的經驗，

cues.text: and the specific value you have brought to other companies.
cues.en: and the specific value you have brought to other companies.
cues.zh: 以及您為其他公司帶來的具體價值。

cues.text: Applying this format to myself, I might write something like "innovative product marketing manager
cues.en: Applying this format to myself, I might write something like "innovative product marketing manager
cues.zh: 將這種格式應用在我自己身上，我可能會寫一些類似「創新產品行銷經理」的內容

cues.text: "with seven-plus years of experience in B2B marketing.
cues.en: "with seven-plus years of experience in B2B marketing.
cues.zh: 「擁有七年多 B2B 行銷經驗。

cues.text: "I help companies identify high potential leads "and I'm responsible for US$121 million
cues.en: "I help companies identify high potential leads "and I'm responsible for US$121 million
cues.zh: 「我幫助公司識別高潛力潛在客戶」並且我負責 1.21 億美元

cues.text: "in acquisition revenue, "representing a 78% growth year-on-year."
cues.en: "in acquisition revenue, "representing a 78% growth year-on-year."
cues.zh: 「在收購收入方面，」年增 78%。

cues.text: Two quick things.
cues.en: Two quick things.
cues.zh: 兩件快事。

cues.text: Number one, if you're a student, focus on your internships and extracurriculars
cues.en: Number one, if you're a student, focus on your internships and extracurriculars
cues.zh: 第一，如果您是學生，請專注於實習和課外活動

cues.text: and make sure to include metrics.
cues.en: and make sure to include metrics.
cues.zh: 並確保包含指標。

cues.text: To give an extreme example, it's better to write "my presentation scored 24% higher than the class average"
cues.en: To give an extreme example, it's better to write "my presentation scored 24% higher than the class average"
cues.zh: 舉個極端的例子，最好寫“我的演講得分比全班平均分數高出24%”

cues.text: than to simply write "I led a team presentation".
cues.en: than to simply write "I led a team presentation".
cues.zh: 而不是簡單地寫「我領導了一次團隊演示」。

cues.text: Number two, I would usually stay away from fluffy buzzwords, such as innovative, but Austin cleverly addresses this issue
cues.en: Number two, I would usually stay away from fluffy buzzwords, such as innovative, but Austin cleverly addresses this issue
cues.zh: 第二，我通常會遠離空洞的流行語，例如創新，但奧斯汀巧妙地解決了這個問題

cues.text: by giving you a chance to provide proof in the next section of your LinkedIn summary,
cues.en: by giving you a chance to provide proof in the next section of your LinkedIn summary,
cues.zh: 讓您有機會在 LinkedIn 摘要的下一部分提供證據，

cues.text: case study bullet points.
cues.en: case study bullet points.
cues.zh: 案例研究要點。

cues.text: In this part I would cherry pick three specific examples that best showcase how your existing skillset
cues.en: In this part I would cherry pick three specific examples that best showcase how your existing skillset
cues.zh: 在這一部分中，我將挑選三個最能展示您現有技能的具體範例

cues.text: will be a great match for the role that you're hoping to land.
cues.en: will be a great match for the role that you're hoping to land.
cues.zh: 將非常適合您希望獲得的職位。

cues.text: Broadly speaking, the structure here will be similar to the bullet point structure found in your resume.
cues.en: Broadly speaking, the structure here will be similar to the bullet point structure found in your resume.
cues.zh: 一般來說，這裡的結構與履歷中的要點結構類似。

cues.text: In the interest of time, I'm just gonna link my resume video down below, so make sure to check that out after this one.
cues.en: In the interest of time, I'm just gonna link my resume video down below, so make sure to check that out after this one.
cues.zh: 由於時間關係，我將在下面連結我的簡歷影片，因此請務必在這之後檢視。

cues.text: Finally, the last section of your summary should speak directly to the opportunities you're looking for,
cues.en: Finally, the last section of your summary should speak directly to the opportunities you're looking for,
cues.zh: 最後，摘要的最後一部分應該直接說明您正在尋找的機會，

cues.text: but without specifically saying you're looking for new opportunities.
cues.en: but without specifically saying you're looking for new opportunities.
cues.zh: 但沒有明確表示您正在尋找新的機會。

cues.text: Austin gives a great tip here by painting a picture of you and your boss at a bar,
cues.en: Austin gives a great tip here by painting a picture of you and your boss at a bar,
cues.zh: 奧斯汀在這裡給了一個很好的建議，他畫了一張你和你老闆在酒吧的照片，

cues.text: along with a recruiter at your dream company.
cues.en: along with a recruiter at your dream company.
cues.zh: 與您夢想公司的招募人員一起。

cues.text: And in order to tip off the recruiter without your manager getting suspicious,
cues.en: And in order to tip off the recruiter without your manager getting suspicious,
cues.zh: 為了在你的經理不產生懷疑的情況下向招聘人員通風報信，

cues.text: you simply mention the type of work that gets you excited.
cues.en: you simply mention the type of work that gets you excited.
cues.zh: 您只需提及讓您感到興奮的工作型別即可。

cues.text: For example, "I love applying my B2B LeadGen experience "to help tech companies reach high growth SMBs
cues.en: For example, "I love applying my B2B LeadGen experience "to help tech companies reach high growth SMBs
cues.zh: 例如，「我喜歡運用我的 B2B LeadGen 經驗」來幫助科技公司實現高成長的中小企業

cues.text: "to further scale their businesses." And any recruiter looking at your profile
cues.en: "to further scale their businesses." And any recruiter looking at your profile
cues.zh: 「進一步擴大他們的業務。」以及任何正在檢視您個人資料的招聘人員

cues.text: will know exactly what you want without you actually saying it.
cues.en: will know exactly what you want without you actually saying it.
cues.zh: 無需你真正說出來，他就會確切地知道你想要什麼。

cues.text: In case my manager is watching this video, that was clearly a hypothetical example.
cues.en: In case my manager is watching this video, that was clearly a hypothetical example.
cues.zh: 如果我的經理正在觀看這段影片，那麼這顯然是一個假設的例子。

cues.text: Let me know down the comment section below whether you're already following a similar structure for your LinkedIn summary
cues.en: Let me know down the comment section below whether you're already following a similar structure for your LinkedIn summary
cues.zh: 請在下面的評論部分告訴我您是否已採用類似的 LinkedIn 摘要結構

cues.text: or you're doing something different.
cues.en: or you're doing something different.
cues.zh: 或者你正在做一些不同的事情。

cues.text: I would love to see what other best practices are out there.
cues.en: I would love to see what other best practices are out there.
cues.zh: 我很想看看還有哪些最佳實踐。

cues.text: Now that we're familiar with three sections that make up an outstanding LinkedIn summary
cues.en: Now that we're familiar with three sections that make up an outstanding LinkedIn summary
cues.zh: 現在我們已經熟悉了構成優秀 LinkedIn 摘要的三個部分

cues.text: and have also seen a few examples, let's quickly go over the five practical tips
cues.en: and have also seen a few examples, let's quickly go over the five practical tips
cues.zh: 並且還看到了一些範例，讓我們快速瀏覽一下五個實用技巧

cues.text: you can apply immediately.
cues.en: you can apply immediately.
cues.zh: 您可以立即申請。

cues.text: Tip number one, LinkedIn recently expanded the limit for the summary section to 2,000 characters.
cues.en: Tip number one, LinkedIn recently expanded the limit for the summary section to 2,000 characters.
cues.zh: 第一個提示，LinkedIn 最近將摘要部分的限制擴大到 2,000 個字元。

cues.text: So first write out your draft, then paste it into a tool like WordCounter
cues.en: So first write out your draft, then paste it into a tool like WordCounter
cues.zh: 因此，先寫出草稿，然後將其貼到 WordCounter 等工具中

cues.text: to make sure you're within LinkedIn's limits.
cues.en: to make sure you're within LinkedIn's limits.
cues.zh: 確保您在 LinkedIn 的限制範圍內。

cues.text: I personally don't think there's a perfect range, but in Austin's examples,
cues.en: I personally don't think there's a perfect range, but in Austin's examples,
cues.zh: 我個人認為沒有一個完美的範圍，但在奧斯汀的例子中，

cues.text: these summaries are between 880 to 1,120 characters.
cues.en: these summaries are between 880 to 1,120 characters.
cues.zh: 這些摘要的長度在 880 到 1,120 個字元之間。

cues.text: Tip number two, since LinkedIn is a search engine just like Google, Amazon, and YouTube,
cues.en: Tip number two, since LinkedIn is a search engine just like Google, Amazon, and YouTube,
cues.zh: 第二點，因為 LinkedIn 是一個搜尋引擎，就像 Google、Amazon 和 YouTube 一樣，

cues.text: keywords play a pretty big role.
cues.en: keywords play a pretty big role.
cues.zh: 關鍵字起著相當大的作用。

cues.text: Recruiters are constantly searching for candidates and when they run a search,
cues.en: Recruiters are constantly searching for candidates and when they run a search,
cues.zh: 招募人員不斷地尋找候選人，當他們進行搜尋時，

cues.text: LinkedIn looks at the keywords and filters in their search and they match them up with the keywords
cues.en: LinkedIn looks at the keywords and filters in their search and they match them up with the keywords
cues.zh: LinkedIn 會檢視搜尋中的關鍵字和篩選器，然後將它們與關鍵字進行匹配

cues.text: on thousands of profiles.
cues.en: on thousands of profiles.
cues.zh: 在數千個個人資料上。

cues.text: To embed the right keywords in your LinkedIn summary, first find a role you're interested in
cues.en: To embed the right keywords in your LinkedIn summary, first find a role you're interested in
cues.zh: 要在 LinkedIn 摘要中嵌入正確的關鍵字，請先找到您感興趣的職位

cues.text: and paste the entire LinkedIn job description in a Word document.
cues.en: and paste the entire LinkedIn job description in a Word document.
cues.zh: 並將整個 LinkedIn 職位描述貼到 Word 檔案中。

cues.text: Do this 19 more times until you have 20 total, then paste those 20 job descriptions
cues.en: Do this 19 more times until you have 20 total, then paste those 20 job descriptions
cues.zh: 再重複 19 次，直到總共 20 份，然後貼上這 20 份職位描述

cues.text: in a word cloud generator like MonkeyLearn WordCloud generator, I'll link that down below,
cues.en: in a word cloud generator like MonkeyLearn WordCloud generator, I'll link that down below,
cues.zh: 在像 MonkeyLearn WordCloud 生成器這樣的詞雲生成器中，我將在下面連結它，

cues.text: and do your best to weave the top five keywords into your LinkedIn summary.
cues.en: and do your best to weave the top five keywords into your LinkedIn summary.
cues.zh: 並盡力將前五個關鍵字編入您的 LinkedIn 摘要中。

cues.text: Of course, this works best if you're very targeted in the type of role you're searching for,
cues.en: Of course, this works best if you're very targeted in the type of role you're searching for,
cues.zh: 當然，如果您對正在尋找的職位型別非常有針對性，那麼這種方法效果最好，

cues.text: for example, marketing for consumer, hardware, electronics.
cues.en: for example, marketing for consumer, hardware, electronics.
cues.zh: 例如，消費者、硬體、電子產品的行銷。

cues.text: If you copy paste job descriptions from 10 complete different unrelated industries and roles,
cues.en: If you copy paste job descriptions from 10 complete different unrelated industries and roles,
cues.zh: 如果您從 10 個完全不同的不相關行業和角色中複製貼上職位描述，

cues.text: you're gonna end up with keywords that are all over the place.
cues.en: you're gonna end up with keywords that are all over the place.
cues.zh: 你最終會得到到處都是的關鍵字。

cues.text: Tip number three, and this something I did not know before reading Austin's article,
cues.en: Tip number three, and this something I did not know before reading Austin's article,
cues.zh: 第三個技巧，這是我在閱讀奧斯汀的文章之前所不知道的，

cues.text: is that you can use a free tool called Unicode Text Converter to bold or italicize words in LinkedIn.
cues.en: is that you can use a free tool called Unicode Text Converter to bold or italicize words in LinkedIn.
cues.zh: 是您可以使用名為 Unicode 文字轉換器的免費工具將 LinkedIn 中的單字設定為粗體或斜體。

cues.text: Simply go to this link, I'll link it down below as well, and type in a sentence or two you'd like to emphasize
cues.en: Simply go to this link, I'll link it down below as well, and type in a sentence or two you'd like to emphasize
cues.zh: 只需轉到此連結，我也會在下面連結它，然後輸入您想要強調的一兩句話

cues.text: in your LinkedIn summary and copy/paste a bold or italicized version of it.
cues.en: in your LinkedIn summary and copy/paste a bold or italicized version of it.
cues.zh: 在您的 LinkedIn 摘要中，複製/貼上其粗體或斜體版本。

cues.text: You can also add emojis.
cues.en: You can also add emojis.
cues.zh: 您也可以新增表情符號。

cues.text: For Mac users, a shortcut is control-command-space and for Window users is the Windows-plus-period shortcut.
cues.en: For Mac users, a shortcut is control-command-space and for Window users is the Windows-plus-period shortcut.
cues.zh: 對於 Mac 使用者，快捷方式是 control-command-space；對於 Window 使用者，快捷方式是 Windows 加句點快捷方式。

cues.text: But for both the Unicode Text Converter and the emojis, I'd use those pretty sparingly.
cues.en: But for both the Unicode Text Converter and the emojis, I'd use those pretty sparingly.
cues.zh: 但對於 Unicode 文字轉換器和表情符號，我會相當謹慎地使用它們。

cues.text: Remember, if everything is highlighted, nothing is highlighted.
cues.en: Remember, if everything is highlighted, nothing is highlighted.
cues.zh: 請記住，如果所有內容都突出顯示，則沒有任何內容突出顯示。

cues.text: Tip number four, Austin recommends bringing up one or two personal interests
cues.en: Tip number four, Austin recommends bringing up one or two personal interests
cues.zh: 提示第四，奧斯汀建議提出一兩個個人興趣

cues.text: to create an instant connection with the reader.
cues.en: to create an instant connection with the reader.
cues.zh: 與讀者建立即時聯絡。

cues.text: Safe topics include food, travel, family, sports, hobbies, and learning.
cues.en: Safe topics include food, travel, family, sports, hobbies, and learning.
cues.zh: 安全的話題包括食物、旅行、家庭、運動、嗜好和學習。

cues.text: The trick here is to make sure to include a specific detail after the general interest.
cues.en: The trick here is to make sure to include a specific detail after the general interest.
cues.zh: 這裡的技巧是確保在一般興趣之後包含具體的細節。

cues.text: This could be something as simple as including a specific team name after mentioning you're a huge basketball fan.
cues.en: This could be something as simple as including a specific team name after mentioning you're a huge basketball fan.
cues.zh: 這可能很簡單，例如在提到您是超級籃球迷後新增一個特定的球隊名稱。

cues.text: Last but not least, tip number five is to use the Hemingway app to check your and spelling.
cues.en: Last but not least, tip number five is to use the Hemingway app to check your and spelling.
cues.zh: 最後但並非最不重要的一點是，第五條提示是使用海明威應用程式檢查您的拼字。

cues.text: Once you've followed all the steps in this video, paste your LinkedIn summary into the app,
cues.en: Once you've followed all the steps in this video, paste your LinkedIn summary into the app,
cues.zh: 完成本影片中的所有步驟後，將您的 LinkedIn 摘要貼到應用程式中，

cues.text: I'll link it down below, and Hemingway will show you misspelled words,
cues.en: I'll link it down below, and Hemingway will show you misspelled words,
cues.zh: 我將在下面連結它，海明威將向您展示拼寫錯誤的單詞，

cues.text: which sentences you can improve and how to improve them, and even give you a readability score.
cues.en: which sentences you can improve and how to improve them, and even give you a readability score.
cues.zh: 您可以改進哪些句子以及如何改進它們，甚至可以為您提供可讀性分數。
